questions.name: Kokonut | Farm summary
questions.description: Active eligible locations, farm and plot counts, and unit-normalized area. Area completeness is explicit.
questions.query: SELECT location_name, country, region, farm_count, plot_count, total_area_ha, area_data_complete FROM kokonut_reporting.v_farm_summary ORDER BY location_name

questions.name: Kokonut | Verified metric values
questions.description: Only human-verified values for explicitly published metric definitions. Period and computation method are retained.
questions.query: SELECT location_name, metric_key, display_name, unit, value, period_start, period_end, computation_method, computed_at, verified_at FROM kokonut_reporting.v_verified_metric_values ORDER BY location_name, metric_key, period_start, period_end, computation_method

questions.name: Kokonut | Celo attestation summary
questions.description: Aggregate Celo attestation counts for eligible locations; excludes payloads, evidence, attester identities, and transaction details.
questions.query: SELECT location_name, claim_type, chain, total_attestations, published_count, first_attestation, latest_attestation FROM kokonut_reporting.v_attestation_summary WHERE chain = 'celo' ORDER BY location_name, claim_type

parity_status: queries execute on the empty candidate; populated output parity remains open
